interpretation: Six flexible target distributions conditioned on Gaia inputs are the minimum. Full joint modeling is desirable, not a launch prerequisite. Visually inspect population correlations/nonlinearities and within-star correlations where genuine joint draws exist.
required_behavior: predict all six targets with flexible marginal uncertainty conditional on Gaia inputs
provide six marginal prediction summaries and distributions or declared uncertainty-region outputs
provide population corner/Kiel plots across predicted stars for correlation and nonlinear trend inspection
provide per-star corner plots from genuine joint predictive draws for models that support them
label marginal-only output as having unestimated within-star dependence; never pair independently drawn marginals to claim learned correlations
retain feature availability and population support flags

survey_mapping.formulation: For source s, compare its observed subset to M_s h_s(theta_6, measurement_conditions_s). Sources need not measure all six targets.
requirements: source errors and shared teacher/measurement dependencies
age/distance teacher mapping distinct from direct physical observations
physically anchored scale in supported regions
source-target maps with no supporting data remain unavailable rather than guessed

primary_comparisons: contrastive-flow model with conformal region calibration
methods.note: Methods are compared for their actual output object. Normalized log_prob is required only for likelihood-based scoring; region methods use coverage and volume/efficiency, with no claim that a region score is a PDF.

evaluation: same inputs, identities, roles and supported target masks
point accuracy plus calibrated multivariate and per-target uncertainty
sample-based proper scores where joint samples exist
region coverage and size/volume where regions are the output
physical seismic/benchmark checks and source-scale residuals
not_required: a normalized-log-density API for every compared method
current_limitations: trained survey mapping presently covers atmospheric three only
six-target pilots are pooled-label rather than expanded six-target mapped-survey training
mapping physical identification remains under investigation
full_joint_requirement: optional model capability; not a prerequisite imposed on every candidate
